# variantly

> Point it at a website that needs a fresh look. The person's own coding agent (Claude Code, Codex CLI or GitHub Copilot CLI) makes several whole-page redesigns with the Impeccable skill; the person flicks between them in a browser and keeps one.

If you are an AI agent setting variantly up for someone, start here:

- [Agent quickstart](https://variantly.tools/#agent): the five commands, in order.
- [SKILLS.md](https://variantly.tools/SKILLS.md): the full manual, written for agents.

Rules: never pick a design for the person; each design is one session on their account, so say so before a large run; nothing touches their files until they keep one.
